correctness.rationale: The structural implication rank 18 => ternary self-duality is exact because the incidence Gram matrix is 0 mod 3. The archived sweep has exactly 1458 uniquely named rows, all reporting RANK 18 MINWEIGHT 6. The representative and six additional spread-out samples were independently parsed and each satisfies row/column sums 15, pairwise row intersections 6, and GF(3)-rank 18. The 3^18 meet-in-the-middle verifier source was inspected; its packed ternary addition and exhaustive 9+9 split cover all information vectors and exclude zero.

originality.rationale: The exact 1458-matrix Goethals-Seidel data set is a concrete reproducibility artifact, but broad novelty should not be claimed: later/nearby literature classifies very large families of symmetric 2-(36,15,6) designs and computes their ternary codes. The record already avoids monomial-equivalence and isomorphism claims.

scientific_value.rationale: The explicit matrices, per-design sweep ledger, and independent minimum-distance verifier form a useful finite dataset showing that full ternary rank need not imply extremality.
